Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 07:20:00 +0000
From: Yusuf Demir <yusuf.demir@anatolia-textile.example>
To: Marek Wiśniewski <owner@example.com>,
 Marek Wiśniewski <owner@outlook.com>
Subject: Sample shipment - tracking and customs papers
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: multipart/mixed; boundary="mix-5b601114"

Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Dear Marek,

the sample shipment left Izmir this morning; the tracking number is in the attached proforma. Customs papers are with the courier. Please let me know within a week whether the fabric weight suits the autumn collection so we can book the production slot.

Kind regards,
Yusuf Demir
Export Manager
Anatolia Textile Ltd.
+90 232 555 01 90
--mix-5b601114
